interface.signature: maxScoreWords(words: List[str], letters: List[str], score: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of words is between 1 and 14, inclusive.
Each word has between 1 and 15 characters, inclusive.
The number of letters is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(letter == 1 for letter in map(len, letters))
preconditions.description: Each letter is a single character.
The score list has 26 elements, one for each letter of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 10 for s in score)
preconditions.description: Each score value is between 0 and 10, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in word) for word in words)
preconditions.description: All words and letters contain only lower case English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(score[ord(c) - ord('a')] for c in word) for word in itertools.product(*(repeat(w, min(w.count(c), letters.count(c)) for c in set(word)) for w in words)) if all(c in letters for c in word))
postconditions.description: The maximum score is the highest possible score that can be achieved by using the given letters to form any combination of the words, considering each letter can only be used once.
